5952.title: Archive retirement discards local edits
5952.rootCauseOneLine: Archiving schedules managed-environment retirement without a dirty-worktree safety check; provider removal forces Git worktree deletion and recursively removes the directory.
5952.proposedFix: Coordinate archive-specific retention and disclosure with a final dirty-state check before teardown; preserve explicit destruction semantics.
5952.caveats: No rendered UI or wall-clock wait; actual archive route and removal reproduced twice. Attached-branch unpushed commits survived. No automatic fix meets the single-subsystem/no-product-decision gate.
